exposure: ORAI1 concentrations in maternal and umbilical cord blood
FGF23 concentrations in maternal and umbilical cord blood
PP13 concentrations in maternal and umbilical cord blood
Palladin concentrations in maternal and umbilical cord blood
Supervillin concentrations in maternal and umbilical cord blood
cohort: The study included 61 women with late-onset pre-eclampsia and 61 normotensive pregnant women, all undergoing cesarean delivery.
finding: Maternal and cord blood ORAI1 concentrations were significantly elevated in pre-eclampsia, while maternal FGF23 and PP13 were decreased, with ORAI1 and combined ORAI1 and FGF23 showing diagnostic potential for late-onset pre-eclampsia.
cross-section timing: Maternal blood samples were collected immediately prior to cesarean delivery, and umbilical cord blood was obtained immediately after delivery of the placenta.
